overall_summary: Husband-wife relationship dynamics and domestic life realities significantly outperform generic shayari or broad emotional topics, generating nearly 10x more views (e.g., 1698 and 1666 views).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about husband-wife dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1698 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1666 views) are clear outliers with massive view counts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more heavily on marital relationship struggles, unspoken expectations, and domestic emotional realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Simple relationship checks like 'आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना' performed decently with 288 views compared to low-performing poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Use direct, second-person addressing ('तुम', 'पति-पत्नी') to anchor the viewer immediately.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…' received only 6 views, showing that abstract or overly dramatic poetic phrasing fails to grip the Shorts feed.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic language in hooks; stick to concrete real-life observations.
